evidence_slice: Planning Data identifies infrastructure project TR010062, A66 Northern Trans-Pennine Project, as an authoritative Planning Inspectorate transport infrastructure project. The Secretary of State granted development consent in the A66 Northern Trans-Pennine Development Consent Order 2024 (S.I. 2024/360), which came into force on 28 March 2024. The A66 Northern Trans-Pennine Development Consent (Amendment) Order 2026 (S.I. 2026/422) came into force on 16 April 2026, and the revised 2024 Order continues to grant development consent for the authorised development.
